subject: general
question: Which of the following ports is located on the western coast of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Cochin.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Cochin Port

 
 
• Cochin Port or Kochi Port is a major port on the Arabian Sea - Laccadive Sea – Indian Ocean sea-route
 
• The port lies on two islands in the Lake of Kochi: Willingdon Island and Vallarpadam, towards the Fort Kochi river mouth opening onto the Laccadive Sea.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• Paradip Port

 
 
• Paradip Port is a natural, deep-water port on the East coast of India in the Jagatsinghpur district of Odisha.
 
• It is situated at the confluence of the Mahanadi river and the Bay of Bengal.
 
 
 
• Mangalore Port
 
 
• New Mangalore Port is a deep-water, all-weather port at Panambur, Mangalore in Karnataka state in India.
 
• It is the deepest inner harbour on the west coast.
 
 
 
• Calicut port is in Kerala.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
